muscle_hypertrophy.volume: 10–20+ sets per muscle group per week

programming.progression: Increase sets, reps, or load linearly

muscle_hypertrophy.exercises: Compound lifts (squat, bench, deadlift, row, overhead press) plus isolation
muscle_hypertrophy.techniques: Progressive overload, drop sets, supersets for advanced trainees
muscle_hypertrophy.recovery: 48h between sessions for a muscle group

methods: Mobility exercises (leg swings, arm circles, lunges, hip openers)
flexibility_range_of_motion.intensity: Hold static stretches 15–60s, 2–4 sets per area
flexibility_range_of_motion.programming: Add stretching at end of workouts, dedicate one session per week to mobility/flexibility
flexibility_range_of_motion.balance: Target opposing muscle groups for symmetrical flexibility
flexibility_range_of_motion.recovery: Foam rolling and gentle stretching on rest days

movement_quality_complexity.philosophy: Train movement, not just muscles (Isolation → Integration → Improvisation)
programming: Regularly improvise and play with movement
movement_quality_complexity.movement_snacks: Short, frequent mobility bursts multiple times/day
movement_quality_complexity.progression: Increase complexity (degrees of freedom), not just sets/reps

exercises: Compound joint-friendly moves: Squat, step-up, row, shoulder press, leg extension
Prehab movements: reverse sled drag, tibialis raises

programming.frequency: 1–2x/week as dedicated session or sprinkled after main workouts

joint_health_prehab_rehab.focus: Corrective exercise, slow eccentrics, isometrics, controlled mobility work
joint_health_prehab_rehab.recovery: Balance and agility work, water-based activity or gentle cardio for off days

principles: Combine strength, cardio, balance, flexibility, and mobility
Prioritize cardiovascular health, balance, and bone density
vitality_longevity_balance.frequency: Most days of the week (4–6x) with varied intensity
vitality_longevity_balance.intensity: Moderate (RPE 5–7/10), avoid high impact unless proficient
vitality_longevity_balance.recovery: Emphasize sleep, stress management, walking, and hydration

routine: Include 1–3 mobility movements within every workout
mobility_recovery_practices.active_recovery: Walking, cycling, swimming, or yoga for off days

key_principles: Rotate focus areas, but integrate mobility and movement quality daily
Use movement snacks—short, frequent mobility bursts—especially for sedentary individuals
Prioritize weakest areas early in the week
Always individualize: progression, regression, and rest based on age, training status, past injury, and preferences
